title: Returned-Transfer Reserve on Debit-Card Cashouts (Cartwise Shopper Payouts)
content:
**Payments Risk reserve — Cartwise Shopper Payouts**

On an instant cashout to an external debit card, a returned-transfer reserve is kept back: an account with two or more returned-transfer entries in the last 12 months keeps back 40.00, an account with exactly one keeps back 20.00, and an account with none keeps back nothing. The reserve stays on the payout balance and is not sent in the cashout.

**What is counted.** A returned-transfer entry is the entry booked on the payout account when a weekly deposit or an instant cashout is sent back by the receiving bank or card and returns to the balance. "The last 12 months" counts the returned-transfer entries booked fewer than 12 whole months before the day of the cashout.

| Returned-transfer entries in the last 12 months | Reserve kept back |
|---|---|
| none | nothing |
| exactly one | 20.00 |
| two or more | 40.00 |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical dates).**
- Two returned-transfer entries, one booked 4 months ago and one booked 12 whole months and a day before the cashout day: only one falls within the last 12 months, so 20.00 is kept back.
- The same two entries, with the older one booked 11 months and 29 days before the cashout day: both count, so 40.00 is kept back.
- Three entries in the last 12 months: "two or more" applies, so the reserve stays at 40.00.
